items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is a two-part representation theorem for Ext groups against a bounded flat complex with proper support: first by cohomology of a perfect object of the base, then by a pseudo-coherent object dual to a homotopy colimit construction (source lines 6009-6131, label lemma-compute-ext). The solver must run an approximation-and-cone reduction with explicit degree bookkeeping, then an inverse/direct system argument whose truncation isomorphisms come from the last nonvanishing cohomology sheaf of a cone; neither half is a routine citation. Allowed background: the chapter's approximation theorem, pseudo-coherent hocolim lemma and dual perfect complex machinery, delivered as navigation pointers.
